message:
## Vulnerability Digest

The 24-hour window was **2026-08-31 13:10 IST to 2026-09-01 13:10 IST** (2026-08-31 07:40 UTC to 2026-09-01 07:40 UTC). This independent DLL scan read, normalized, and deduplicated only `DLL_software_component.txt`; `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

No fresh, credible vulnerability report was verified as a direct match to a component and version in the assigned DLL inventory.

**Mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep**

MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise), `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, ODBC Driver, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, major officially maintained libraries and services, MongoDB-owned advisories, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, CISA sources, and national CERT notices were checked.

**Possible match needing review: MongoDB Connector for BI and BI Connector ODBC Driver**

- Product: MongoDB Connector for BI (`mongosqld` / schema tooling) and MongoDB BI Connector ODBC Driver
- Issues: CVE-2026-77184, CVE-2026-77586, CVE-2026-81490, CVE-2026-81517, CVE-2026-81518, CVE-2026-81520, CVE-2026-81532, and CVE-2026-81533
- Severity: **High overall** in the CERT-Bund advisory; individual CVEs include medium and high ratings
- Description: The grouped issues cover SQL injection paths, authentication and TLS validation weaknesses, pre-authentication connection exhaustion, information disclosure, and ODBC memory-safety flaws that can crash or corrupt a hosting process.
- Why it appears relevant: This was found by the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep. Neither MongoDB BI Connector nor its ODBC Driver is named in the assigned DLL file, so deployment relevance cannot be confirmed from this inventory and requires an asset check.
- Freshness: CERT-Bund published the grouped advisory on 2026-08-31, and associated CVE records received updates during the scan window. The underlying MongoDB CVEs were initially published on 2026-08-28, so they are not presented as newly assigned CVEs.
- Sources: [CERT-Bund advisory WID-SEC-2026-3082](https://wid.cert-bund.de/portal/wid/securityadvisory?name=WID-SEC-2026-3082), [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB Connector for BI release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/release-notes/)

**Closing**

No immediate action is indicated from a confirmed DLL inventory match. Promptly verify whether MongoDB Connector for BI or its ODBC Driver is deployed; if present, treat the high-rated grouped advisory as an immediate review item.
